contribution.position: I hold my earlier position: on the reliability axis the evidence still points against shipping this week. artifact:perf-report measures peak_memory at 740MB against a 512MB budget — a 44% overage under load — and that resource pressure directly amplifies the retry-storm failure mode behind last quarter's two sev2 incidents (artifact:incident-log). The 412 passing tests and 87% coverage (artifact:test-report) establish functional correctness but do not exercise memory headroom at peak, so the reliability concern remains unresolved until the overage is explained, re-measured, or fixed.
